header.running_head: 3. Belief in the Events after Death...

blocks.tamil_translation: will forget the one she was nursing (her child); every pregnant woman will drop her burden - (will give birth); and you (O Prophet) will see people dazed (from the intensity of terror); yet they are not dazed (by wine) - rather, the punishment of Allah will be most severe.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَلَا يَسْئَلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيماً ۞ يُّبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ؕ يَوَدُّ الْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِي مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍ م بِبَنِيهِ ۞ وَصَاحِبَتِهِ وَأَخِيهِ ۞ وَفَصِيلَتِهِ الَّتِي تُئْوِيهِ ۞ وَمَنْ فِي اْلاَرْضِ جَمِيعاً لا ثُمَّ يُنْجِيهِ ۞ كَلَّا۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: No friend will ask after another friend, though they will be shown (to their friends) (on that Day; yet each one, out of worry for himself, will not speak to others). And the guilty one will wish to give as ransom for the punishment of that Day his children, his wife, his brother, his relatives who sheltered him, and all who are on the earth (giving them as ransom for the punishment of that Day), and then save himself. (But that) will never be.

blocks.arabic_text: وَقَالَ تَعَالي: (وَلَا تَحْسَبَنَّ اللهَ غَافِلاً عَمَّا يَعْمَلُ الظَّالِمُونَ ؕ إِنَّمَا يُؤَخِّرُهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ تَشْخَصُ فِيهِ اْلاَبْصَارُ۞ مُهْطِعِينَ مُقْنِعِي رُءُوسِهِمْ لَايَرْتَدُّ إِلَيْهِمْ طَرْفُهُمْ ۚ وَأَفْئِدَتُهُمْ هَوَآءٌ۞).
blocks.tamil_translation: (O Prophet,) do not ever think that Allah is unaware of what the wrongdoers do; He only delays them (without destroying them) for a Day on which eyes will stare fixedly
